posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
I feel like I should update this thread with recent major wiki developments.

One, between myself and WalkingTarget we now have a spiffy gallery of all the Faux Comics Covers that have been made for the Multiverse:

https://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=Category:Comic_Covers

Two, WalkingTarget's been working on creating some summary pages for the major ongoing titles in the Multiverse:

  • https://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=Tome_of_the_Bizarre
  • https://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=Mystery_Comics
  • https://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=Freedom_Five_Annual
  • https://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=Freedom_Five_(Comic)
  • https://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=Justice_Comics

Three, I did a major redesign of the individual Podcast Episode pages. Example here:

https://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=Podcasts/Episode_19

I basically wanted to do a few things:

  1. Put the Summary front and center instead of hidden behind a second click. Because I mean, pretty much the whole reason to go to the episode pages is to read the summaries.
  2. Make everything more clean, tidy, and readable.
  3. Make it more modular since different episodes contain different subsets of information.
  4. Make it flow and look better on mobile and other smaller screens.
  5. Make it more comic book-y looking.

I'm now going through all the old episode pages to do some copyediting and clean them up a bit, add some images where we can, and so on, but the redesign should still already work on every episode page right now.

Next projects in progress for me: Redesigning the Main Page and adding info from the Sentinels of Freedom video game to the character pages.
